entries.summary: Implemented per-user GitHub video segmentation. Each user connects their own GitHub account, video segments uploaded to their personal repo.
entries.details: New model: GitHubAccount (user, github_username, github_token, repo_name). API: GET/POST/DELETE /courses/github/. Video upload now uses user's GitHub token. Auto-creates repo if not exists. Frontend: GitHubConnect.tsx component.
decisions: Each user has their own GitHub repo
Token verified via GitHub API before saving
If no GitHub connected, saves locally only
